verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a substantial first-party API reference: a docs site, a plain-text /llms-api.txt endpoint reference, and a live OpenAPI spec with 174 paths. It also ships an unauthenticated Developer MCP that lets AI assistants search and read the reference and schemas, and a sandbox API base (demo-api.ramp.com) for safe test calls. Nothing shows the reference itself has in-page runnable or try-it examples, so the 'interactive with runnable examples' part is unproven. Missing for 10: documented in-browser try-it/runnable request console in the API reference, runnable code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of an interactive reference experience.
